name: ForgeSmith — 锻造强化
description: Smithing-table gear upgrades for vanilla armor and tools: ingots boost armor toughness & knockback resistance (armor), sword damage, pickaxe/shovel speed, axe durability; redstone grants max health (armor) and unbreaking (tools); lapis grants water resistance (armor) and conduit power (tools); emerald grants regeneration (armor) and lifesteal (tools). Up to 3 layers per item, higher-tier ingots override lower ones.
